affectedPublicSurfaces: api.app-juli.com — TikTok-backed data freshness depends on a durable credential; no route contract changes

candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: Local pytest on feature/issue-745; production verification is a single reconcile run against the Fujiwa reference shop

journeys.name: token-refresh-durability
assertions: a refreshed token is readable from a new session after the refresh returns
a rotated refresh_token is persisted, not the one that was sent
a response omitting refresh_token retains the existing refresh token and does not raise
the REFRESH_BUFFER early-return still short-circuits without an HTTP call or write
persisted refresh_token remains encrypted with the enc:v1: prefix and no plaintext token appears in logs
tiktok_credentials.updated_at advances and token_expires_at moves into the future after one production reconcile

migrationCompatibility.notes: No schema change. tiktok_credentials already has access_token, refresh_token and token_expires_at; this only makes an existing write durable. Stable and candidate read the same columns, so a rollback mid-deploy leaves rows readable by both.

rollbackAssertion.preCutoverFailureBehavior: Do not merge. Refreshes continue to be rolled back — the credential does not degrade further than today, but the 30-minute buffer stays permanently ineffective and every job re-refreshes.
rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: Revert the commit. Rows already persisted by the fixed code remain valid — they hold the newest tokens TikTok issued, which is strictly better than the pre-fix state. Reverting resumes discarding refreshes; it cannot corrupt a stored credential.

acceptanceCommands: python -m pytest tests/unit -q -k 'oauth or credential or token'
doNotInfer: this adds a distributed lock — single-flight refresh is explicitly deferred; a narrow race remains if two workers read an expired credential simultaneously
this adds reactive 401 refresh — TikTokClient holds a token snapshot, so refresh stays proactive via REFRESH_BUFFER
this tracks refresh-token expiry — refresh_token_expire_in is still ignored and there is no column or alert for it
this fixes the empty bronze/silver/gold tables — that is blocked by #744 unbounded pagination and is a separate path
